Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 03:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIRST SEMESTER M.TECH EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Research Methodology andTechnical Communication [HUM_5051]  
Marks: 20                                                                                                        Duration: 60 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                What is scientific research? Elaborate of different types of research based on enquiry.                (3)  
  
  
  A)                                                      Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           You are a consultant in an MNC named World Research Institute of Sustainability. While working         (4)  
  you identify the research gap that exists on eco-friendly habits of individuals. You want to  
  understand the motivation of an individual to indulge in environmental behaviours positively. What  
  steps are involved to conduct this study? Explain in detail about your project  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           How are research results presented? What is the difference between results and interpretation?         (3)  
  How are results calibrated that leads to discussion in a report?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                What is the difference between literature survey and literature review? How literature review play     (3)  
  significant part in research?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           You are a scholar working in a laboratory research who has collected the data and is about the         (3)  
  start of the analysis. What precaution must be considered and which methodology do you apply?  
  Explain in detail. Draw the steps of analysis that you would consider by justifying the reasons for  
  choosing the same.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           What is ethical research? Why is it considered important in scientific research? How ethical           (4)  
  research is evaluated?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
